title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: Snyk
providers.scope_notes: Snyk SaaS; API access, service accounts and audit logs require the Enterprise plan, while Free/Team personal tokens work only for CLI/IDE/CI.

controls.name: Service account role
controls.what: The assigned Group or Org role (incl. custom roles) sets what the token can do; Group Viewer gives read-only.
controls.setting: Group/Org Settings > Service accounts > Role; role_id in POST /service_accounts

controls.name: Service account creation restricted to admins
controls.what: Only Group admins (Group accounts) or Org Admins/Group admins (Org accounts) can create service accounts.

controls.name: access_token_expires_at
controls.what: Expiry date for access_token service accounts, at most one year.

controls.name: Delete service account
controls.what: Deletes the account and invalidates its token or credentials immediately.

controls.name: Audit logs
controls.what: Group and Org audit log search (90 days) incl. service account and app lifecycle and api.access events.

no_control.what: auth_type api_key service accounts never expire.

controls_unknown: Whether PATs, legacy API tokens or service account tokens bypass SSO / IdP conditional access (not stated).
Any admin setting to disable PATs or legacy API tokens, or to revoke another user's personal token (none documented).
Whether removing a user from a Group/Org or the IdP invalidates their PAT/legacy token (not stated).
Any customer IP allowlist for API requests (none documented).
Audit event names for PAT and legacy token create/revoke (not in the documented event lists).
Contents of api.access events (which fields identify the token or service account).
Admin approval or allowlist for Snyk App installation.
Refresh token lifetime for Snyk Apps.

auth_paths.name: Service account token (auth_type access_token or legacy api_key)

authentication.summary: Group- or Org-level system user whose token is shown once at creation and used like a user token. access_token type has an expiry; api_key type is a legacy key with no expiry.

ip_restriction.boundary: Snyk docs describe no customer-configurable IP allowlist for API callers; IP lists in docs cover Snyk scanners reaching your targets.

lifetime.summary: access_token: up to 1 year; api_key: never expires

renewal.summary: On expiry you must create a new service account.

administration.summary: Group admins create Group accounts; Org Admins (Group members) or Group admins create Org accounts. Role sets scope; Org accounts cannot exceed creator's privileges; read-only only via Group Viewer. Admins delete to revoke.

offboard.details: Service accounts are system users tied to the Group or Organization, not to a person.

inventory.details: Settings > Service accounts lists them; API GET /rest/groups/{groupId}/service_accounts and GET /rest/orgs/{orgId}/service_accounts.

disable.ui: Group > Settings > Member roles > open role > clear service account create permissions > Update Role Permissions

log_sources.name: Snyk audit logs (Group/Org search API)
log_sources.notes: Enterprise; past 90 days; GET /rest/groups/{group_id}/audit_logs/search and /rest/orgs/{org_id}/audit_logs/search; api.access hidden unless requested via events=api.access.

log_sources.name: Event forwarding (Amazon EventBridge, AWS CloudTrail Lake)
log_sources.notes: Platform audit events, Enterprise; use for retention beyond 90 days.

lifecycle_events.notes: Exists in Group and Org event lists; excluded by default; described as high-volume low-information.

anomaly_cues: Service account with Group Admin role
Service account created outside change process

containment.steps: Delete the service account in Settings > Service accounts or DELETE /rest/{groups|orgs}/{id}/service_accounts/{serviceaccount_id}.

unknown: Which field in api.access identifies a service account

calls.log_notes: Enterprise; api.access hidden by default; per-call detail not documented.
Reads have no explicit action event.

calls.reveals: All vulnerability findings for the Org
calls.log_notes: Reads have no explicit action event.

detections.detects: A Snyk group or org service account was created, deleted, edited, or had its membership changed.
